{
  "name": "alageum-node-strapi",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Bounded Node.js/Strapi migration; not a production cutover",
  "scripts": {
    "develop": "strapi develop",
    "build": "strapi build",
    "start": "strapi start",
    "test": "node --test tests/*.test.js",
    "test:integration": "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.integration.js",
    "check": "node scripts/strapi-webpack-patch.js --check && node scripts/check-media-package.js && node scripts/check-page-editor-adapter.js && node scripts/check-syntax.js && npm test",
    "postinstall": "node scripts/strapi-webpack-patch.js --apply",
    "predevelop": "node scripts/strapi-webpack-patch.js --check && node scripts/check-media-package.js && node scripts/check-page-editor-adapter.js",
    "prebuild": "node scripts/strapi-webpack-patch.js --check && node scripts/check-media-package.js && node scripts/check-page-editor-adapter.js",
    "prestart": "node scripts/strapi-webpack-patch.js --check && node scripts/check-media-package.js && node scripts/check-page-editor-adapter.js"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24 <25"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@strapi/strapi": "5.56.0",
    "@strapi/plugin-users-permissions": "5.56.0",
    "pg": "8.16.3",
    "jsonwebtoken": "9.0.2",
    "argon2": "0.44.0",
    "uuid": "11.1.1",
    "decimal.js": "10.6.0",
    "zod": "4.1.12",
    "react": "18.3.1",
    "react-dom": "18.3.1",
    "react-router-dom": "6.30.6",
    "styled-components": "6.1.19",
    "path-browserify": "1.0.1",
    "util": "0.12.5",
    "process": "0.11.10"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "axios": "1.20.0",
    "dompurify": "3.4.16",
    "markdown-it": "14.3.1",
    "postcss": "8.5.28",
    "@strapi/provider-email-sendmail": {
      "nodemailer": "10.0.13"
    },
    "@strapi/strapi": {
      "vite": "6.4.3",
      "webpack-dev-middleware": "7.4.6"
    }
  }
}
